regime_context: The TSX detector shows Big Banks as the durable, eligible leader with broad participation (breadth 1.0) but crowded. The absolute-trend gate—the only validated risk-control edge—is active for this market, while cross-sectional momentum rank has no predictive power. Rotation is not directional and no confirmed handoff exists. Macro backdrop is dominated by geopolitics and AI/tech narratives, providing coincident context only.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: The absolute-trend gate validates a durable uptrend, which historically lowers drawdowns, making this a risk-management tilt. Momentum rank offers no return forecast and the theme is crowded, so only a modest, falsifiable lean is appropriate.
theses.dissent: High crowding and zero rank-IC suggest mean-reversion risk; a shift in rate expectations from geopolitics could pressure banks.

falsifier.text: Big Banks lose eligibility (absolute-trend gate flips to false) – e.g., ZEB.TO falls below its 200-day moving average.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: The trend gate, the only validated edge for avoiding drawdowns, is false for Gold Miners, indicating unfavorable trend health. Being long may increase downside risk until gate improves.
theses.dissent: Gold miners could rally on safe-haven demand from geopolitical spikes, overcoming poor trend; gate-based avoidance may miss sharp upside.

falsifier.text: Gold Miners regain eligibility (trend gate turns true) and durability_bar rises above 0.5.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Despite trend-gate eligibility, low durability (0.47) and very narrow breadth (0.111) suggest the uptrend is fragile and lacks staying power. Reducing exposure here is consistent with the gate's risk ethos.
theses.dissent: Copper may benefit from energy-transition narratives and supply constraints, and the gate may still prevent deep drawdowns even in a narrow trend.

falsifier.text: Base Metals durability_bar rises above 0.6 and breadth expands above 0.3.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
